# TechTarget

> TechTarget is a global network of enterprise technology websites and contributors delivering news, analysis, and reference content on IT, healthcare technology, IoT, and digital transformation.

TechTarget serves enterprise IT leaders and healthcare technology professionals with specialized knowledge hubs covering emerging technologies like AI, cloud computing, and healthcare IT. The platform combines news, definitions, and expert contributor insights across multiple vertical markets.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise AI
- Healthcare IT
- Cloud Computing
- Cybersecurity
- IoT
- Data Management
- Digital Health
- Customer Experience
- Agentic AI
- Healthcare Technology
- Enterprise Software
- Telehealth
- Revenue Cycle Management
- ESG and Sustainability
- DevOps

## News and Analysis

- [TechTarget Enterprise Technology News](https://www.techtarget.com/news): Enterprise technology news covering AI, automation, and customer experience updates
- [TechTarget - Global Network of Information Technology Websites and Contributors](https://www.techtarget.com): TechTarget homepage showcasing enterprise tech news, products, and industry updates

## Healthcare Technology Verticals

- [Healthcare Payers Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/healthcarepayers): Healthcare payers resource covering Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and reimbursement strategies
- [Healthcare Analytics Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechanalytics): Healthcare analytics resource for data governance, predictive analytics, and AI applications
- [Healthtech Security Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/healthtechsecurity): Healthcare security resource covering HIPAA compliance and cybersecurity strategies
- [Patient Engagement Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/patientengagement): Patient engagement resource covering AI chatbots, health tech, and digital health solutions
- [Virtual healthcare information, news and tips](https://www.techtarget.com/virtualhealthcare): Virtual healthcare resource covering telehealth, remote monitoring, and mobile health services
- [Revenue Cycle Management Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/revcyclemanagement): Revenue cycle management resource covering claims processing and healthcare reimbursement
- [Pharma and Life Sciences Information, News and Tips](https://www.techtarget.com/pharmalifesciences): Pharma and life sciences resource covering drug development, clinical trials, and biotech

## Enterprise Technology Verticals

- [Search IoT Information, News and Tips from TechTarget](https://www.techtarget.com/iotagenda): IoT resource covering enterprise technologies, platforms, security, and deployment strategies
- [Sustainability and ESG Information, News and Tips from TechTarget](https://www.techtarget.com/sustainability): Sustainability and ESG resource for enterprise leaders on green tech and compliance

## Reference and Definitions

- [WhatIs - IT Definitions & Tech Explainers for Business Leaders | TechTarget](https://www.techtarget.com/whatis): IT glossary and definitions covering cybersecurity, AI, and enterprise technology terms
